first.hypothesis: Missing expired-lease reclaim causes crash-restart loss; fix selects due scheduled/retrying plus stale claimed via 60s cutoff and guards UPDATE with same predicate.
first.explanation: Claim must also reclaim expired leases: eligible if due scheduled/retrying or claimed with claimed_at<=now-60s inclusive. Select with OR and cutoff, then conditional UPDATE rechecking eligibility to avoid stealing fresh claims and losing races, bumping attempt_count once.

final.hypothesis: Original only selects due scheduled/retrying so crash-restart stale claimed jobs are never reclaimed; repair adds inclusive claimed_at<=now-60000 reclaim to both SELECT and guarded UPDATE.
final.explanation: Eligibility is due scheduled/retrying plus expired claimed leases inclusive at now-60s. Select with unified OR predicate ordered by due_at, then conditional UPDATE re-validating the same predicate inside transaction so fresh claimed, future, and completed rows cannot be stolen and races lose, incrementing attempt_count once.
